subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Context-free calculations to 75

show.line: Friends of twenty! Fifteen and five make twenty. Twelve and eight make twenty. Use your friends of ten to help.

rounds.prompt: Fourteen dots in the two ten frames. How many empty spaces to make twenty?
rounds.praise: Six! Fourteen and six make twenty.
Three! Seventeen and three make twenty.

rounds.prompt: Eleven and what make twenty? Say the number.

rounds.praise: Yes! Thirteen and seven make twenty.
Six! Nine and six make fifteen.

rounds.story: Twenty eggs fit in the box. Sixteen eggs are in. How many more eggs are needed to fill it?
rounds.praise: Four! Sixteen and four make twenty.

hints: Think of friends of ten. Four and six make ten, so fourteen and six make twenty.
Count on from the number until you reach twenty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the friend of eighteen.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Eighteen and two make twenty. Eighteen and three is twenty-one.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on together. Eighteen, nineteen, twenty. That is two more!

parent_line: Knows the pairs of numbers that make 15 and 20.
